WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(sm.facetresmm / sm.geomdeltamm) AS site_ratio
  FROM sites s
  INNER JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
    AND sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL
    AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL
    AND sm.geomdeltamm != 0
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    insurstat,
    AVG(site_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
filtered_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sr.zoneregistry,
    sr.insurstat,
    sr.site_ratio,
    sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios sr
  JOIN status_averages sa ON sr.insurstat = sa.insurstat
  WHERE sr.site_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  insurstat,
  AVG(site_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
  COUNT(*) AS kept_site_count,
  AVG(site_ratio - status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess
FROM filtered_sites
GROUP BY insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: Division by zero (geomdeltamm = 0) is treated as a missing ratio and excluded from the calculation
